task: Read all of Bob's calendar events scheduled for 2024-05-01 (sleeping, lunch, nap, class, dinner), generate a concise summary of these events including their titles and corresponding start and end times in a new Word document named 'bob_may01_schedule.docx', and send an email to Bob containing the summary of these events. The Word document should contain the list of events with their times clearly listed. The email should summarize the day's events and mention that the schedule file has been created.
query_sentence: Prepare a summary of all calendar events for Bob on 2024-05-01 by creating a document and sending an email with the schedule.

ground_truth_memory.fact: The output Word file should be named 'bob_may01_schedule.docx' and saved to the data directory.

Include all event titles and their start/end times in the Word document summary for 2024-05-01: sleeping (08:00-11:00), lunch (12:00-13:00), nap (13:00-14:00), class (16:00-18:00), dinner (18:30-19:30).
The email to Bob should mention that the summary schedule for 2024-05-01 has been created and list all event names.
